free_text: The 74-year-old male has prostate adenocarcinoma with a biopsy Gleason score of 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2), though AI predicts grade group 4. MRI shows a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right peripheral zone, with clinical T stage cT1c. The management assessment is to review individual treatment benefit and preferences. The trade-off involves balancing the risk of progression against the potential benefits of treatment given the intermediate pathological findings.
